title: Equity Accounting Method–Recognition of Losses
summary: Addressed how much loss an investor should recognise under the equity method when its share of an associate's losses exceeds its interest in that associate. Superseded in 2003.

related.relationship: The parent standard whose 2003 revision superseded SIC-20 by incorporating the net investment loss recognition limit directly into the equity method guidance
